metadata.short_desc: Intelligently decide whether to enable deep thinking each turn
metadata.desc: Before each main-model reply, a judge model scores whether this turn warrants deep thinking, then this plugin temporarily enables or disables thinking on the same chat provider using a think-density threshold. The goal is smarter depth selection: reason carefully when the conversation needs it, and stay light for casual turns. It does not register a second chat provider; it only edits custom_extra_body (DeepSeek-style thinking by default). Disabled by default; when enabled, judges once per Agent turn and reuses the decision for tool follow-ups.

enable.hint: Off by default. When on, a judge model decides whether to enable deep thinking before each reply.

think_density.hint: Higher values enable deep thinking more easily. The judge scores 0–100; thinking turns on when score ≥ (100 − density). 50 = neutral; 70 = more eager; 30 = more restrained. Very short messages still skip judging.

judge_provider_id.hint: Pick from providers already configured in AstrBot. Leave empty to use the current session chat model.

judge_prompt.hint: Ask the model to output only a 0–100 integer for how much deep thinking is needed. The density threshold then decides on/off.

thinking_enabled_body.description: JSON written to custom_extra_body when thinking is on

thinking_disabled_body.description: JSON written to custom_extra_body when thinking is off
